headline: Flutterwave Calls for Stable Government Policy to Attract Fintech Capital
summary: Flutterwave CEO Gbenga Agboola urged Nigerian authorities to establish predictable regulatory policies. The enterprise payments firm is seeking enhanced public-private coordination to grow Lagos State's digital economy.
why: Flutterwave is one of Africa's largest digital payments unicorns, facilitating cross-border business transactions.

impacts.name: Flutterwave
impacts.why: Predictable fintech regulation improves capital attraction and processing expansion.
